name: Perfect Steamed Boiled Eggs

instructions.primary_message: If serving eggs cold, add one tray of ice cubes to a large bowl and fill with water.

Add 2.5 cm of water to a large pot. Place steamer insert inside, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Add eggs to steamer basket, cover, and continue cooking: 6 minutes for soft-boiled eggs or 12 minutes for hard-boiled.
Serve immediately if serving hot. If serving cold, immediately place eggs in bowl of ice water and allow to cool for at least 15 minutes before peeling.

To peel, first gently tap hard-boiled eggs all over to thoroughly crack the shell, then remove shell under a thin stream of running water. (The water helps get under the shell and lift it off the egg.)

schema_metadata.keywords: boiled egg, breakfast, brunch, easy, egg, hard-boiled egg, low carb, quick, steam

description: Steaming cooks eggs more gently, yielding easy-to-peel "hard-boiled" eggs with tender whites.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1 tray of ice cubes (optional; for serving cold)

Make-ahead and storage: Store shell-on cooked eggs in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. Store peeled eggs in the refrigerator for up to 1 day.
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
